# Reboil documentation

Small, fast, and scalable string-path state access for web applications and React Native, with code splitting, and synchronous persistence out of the box

The core store API is framework agnostic and works with vanilla JavaScript or any web framework. React bindings are available as an optional integration.

Recommended reading:
- /docs/overview
- /docs/getting-started/installation
- /docs/getting-started/quick-start
- /docs/getting-started/platform-support
- /docs/concepts/typed-paths
- /docs/concepts/lazy-stores
- /docs/concepts/persistence
- /docs/reference/api
- /docs/agents

Machine-readable resources:
- /llms-full.txt — complete public contract
- /docs.json — stable topic and resource index
- /skills/reboil/SKILL.md — downloadable Codex Reboil skill entrypoint
- /skills/reboil/references/contract.md — Codex detailed integration and implementation contract
- /skills/claude-code/reboil/SKILL.md — downloadable Claude Code Reboil skill entrypoint
- /skills/claude-code/reboil/references/contract.md — Claude Code detailed integration and implementation contract

Install project-local Codex and Claude Code skills with `npx reboil --prepare agents`.
